scenarios.descriptionTr: Check-in bankosunda pasaport, bagaj, koltuk seçimi ve biniş kartı.

words.definitionEn: an official document you need to travel to other countries
words.exampleEn: Can I see your passport, please?

words.definitionEn: a journey in a plane
words.exampleEn: My flight leaves at seven in the morning.

words.definitionEn: to show your ticket at an airport or register at a hotel
words.noteTr: Havalimanında ve otelde kullanılır. İsim hali: check-in.
words.exampleEn: I need to check in two hours before the flight.
words.exampleTr: Uçuştan iki saat önce check-in yapmam gerekiyor.

words.definitionEn: the bags you take when you travel
words.noteTr: Sayılamaz: 'a luggage' denmez. Bir parça için 'a piece of luggage' denir.
words.exampleEn: How much luggage do you have?

words.definitionEn: a small bag you take with you onto the plane
words.exampleEn: You can take one carry-on bag on the plane.

words.definitionEn: to measure how heavy something is
words.exampleEn: My suitcase weighs twenty kilos.

words.definitionEn: a seat next to the window on a plane, bus or train
words.exampleEn: I'd prefer a window seat, please.
words.exampleTr: Cam kenarı bir koltuk tercih ederim lütfen.

words.definitionEn: a seat next to the aisle (the passage between seats)
words.exampleEn: Could I have an aisle seat? I have long legs.
words.exampleTr: Koridor tarafı alabilir miyim? Bacaklarım uzun.

words.definitionEn: a card you must show to get on a plane
words.exampleEn: Please show your boarding pass at the gate.

words.definitionEn: the place in an airport where you get on the plane
words.exampleEn: Our flight boards at gate twelve.
words.exampleTr: Uçağımıza biniş on iki numaralı kapıdan.

words.definitionEn: at the planned time, not late
words.exampleEn: Is the train on time today?

words.definitionEn: late; happening later than planned
words.exampleEn: Our flight is delayed by one hour.

words.definitionEn: the act of leaving a place, especially a plane or train
words.exampleEn: Please check the departure time on the screen.
words.exampleTr: Lütfen ekrandan kalkış saatini kontrol edin.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: Good morning. Where are you flying to today?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.en: Good morning. I'm flying to London.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: Can I see your passport, please?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.en: Sure, here you are.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: Thank you. Do you have any luggage to check in?
dialogue.tr: Teşekkürler. Check-in yapılacak bagajınız var mı?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.en: Yes, just this suitcase. This small bag is my carry-on.
dialogue.tr: Evet, sadece bu bavul. Bu küçük çanta el bagajım.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: Please put it on the scale so I can weigh it.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: Would you like a window seat or an aisle seat?
dialogue.tr: Cam kenarı mı yoksa koridor tarafı mı istersiniz?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.en: An aisle seat, please.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: Here is your boarding pass. Your flight leaves from gate 24.
dialogue.tr: Biniş kartınız burada. Uçuşunuz 24 numaralı kapıdan kalkıyor.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.en: Is the flight on time?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: I'm afraid it's delayed by about thirty minutes. Please check the departure screens.
dialogue.tr: Maalesef yaklaşık otuz dakika rötarlı. Lütfen kalkış ekranlarını kontrol edin.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.en: No problem. Thank you!

scenarios.descriptionTr: Resepsiyonda rezervasyon, oda, kahvaltı ve çıkış saati.

words.definitionEn: an arrangement to keep a room, table or seat for you
words.exampleEn: I have a reservation for two nights.

words.definitionEn: to arrange to have a room, seat or ticket
words.noteTr: Fiil olarak 'kitap' değil 'ayırtmak' demek. 'I booked a room' = Oda ayırttım.
words.exampleEn: I booked a room online last week.
words.exampleTr: Geçen hafta internetten bir oda ayırttım.

words.definitionEn: a hotel room for one person
words.exampleEn: I'd like a single room for tonight.
words.exampleTr: Bu gece için tek kişilik bir oda istiyorum.

words.definitionEn: free to use or get
words.exampleEn: Do you have any rooms available this weekend?
words.exampleTr: Bu hafta sonu boş odanız var mı?

words.definitionEn: a polite way to say what you want
words.noteTr: 'I want' yerine 'I'd like' çok daha kibar. = I would like.
words.exampleEn: I'd like a cup of coffee, please.

words.definitionEn: the first meal of the day
words.exampleEn: Breakfast is served from seven to ten.
words.exampleTr: Kahvaltı yediden ona kadar servis edilir.

words.definitionEn: part of the price or the group
words.exampleEn: Is Wi-Fi included in the price?

words.definitionEn: a level of a building
words.exampleEn: Your room is on the fifth floor.

words.definitionEn: a plastic card used to open a hotel room door
words.exampleEn: My key card doesn't work.

words.definitionEn: a machine that takes people up and down in a building
words.exampleEn: The elevator is next to the reception.

words.definitionEn: to pay and leave a hotel
words.exampleEn: We have to check out before noon.

words.definitionEn: a phone call from the hotel to wake you up
words.exampleEn: Could I get a wake-up call at six?
words.exampleTr: Saat altıda uyandırma servisi alabilir miyim?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.en: Good evening. Welcome to the Grand Hotel. How can I help you?
dialogue.tr: İyi akşamlar. Grand Otel'e hoş geldiniz. Size nasıl yardımcı olabilirim?

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.en: Hi, I have a reservation under the name Demir.
dialogue.tr: Merhaba, Demir adına bir rezervasyonum var.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.en: Let me check. Yes, a single room for three nights. Is that right?
dialogue.tr: Bir bakayım. Evet, üç gecelik tek kişilik oda. Doğru mu?

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.en: Yes, that's right. I booked it online.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.en: Could I see your passport and a credit card, please?
dialogue.tr: Pasaportunuzu ve bir kredi kartı görebilir miyim lütfen?

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.en: Here you are. Is breakfast included?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.en: Yes, it is. Breakfast is served from seven to ten in the restaurant.
dialogue.tr: Evet, dahil. Kahvaltı restoranda yediden ona kadar servis ediliyor.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.en: Your room is 512, on the fifth floor. Here is your key card.
dialogue.tr: Odanız 512, beşinci katta. Oda kartınız burada.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.en: Thank you. Where is the elevator?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.en: It's just around the corner, on your left.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.en: And what time do I have to check out?
dialogue.tr: Peki saat kaçta çıkış yapmam gerekiyor?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.en: Check-out is at twelve noon.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.en: Great. I'd like a wake-up call at seven, please.
dialogue.tr: Harika. Saat yedide uyandırma servisi istiyorum lütfen.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.en: Of course. Enjoy your stay!

scenarios.descriptionTr: Masa isteme, sipariş verme, alerji söyleme ve hesabı isteme.

words.definitionEn: a table for two people
words.noteTr: 'A table for four, please' gibi sayıyı değiştirerek kullanılır.
words.exampleEn: Hi, a table for two, please.
words.exampleTr: Merhaba, iki kişilik bir masa lütfen.

words.definitionEn: a list of food and drinks in a restaurant
words.exampleEn: Could we see the menu, please?

words.definitionEn: a polite way to ask for something
words.noteTr: Bir şey isterken en kibar ve en çok kullanılan kalıp. 'Can I have' de olur.
words.exampleEn: Could I have a glass of water, please?
words.exampleTr: Bir bardak su alabilir miyim lütfen?

words.definitionEn: with bubbles
words.exampleEn: Would you like still or sparkling water?
words.exampleTr: Gazsız mı gazlı su mu istersiniz?

words.definitionEn: to say that something is good
words.exampleEn: What do you recommend?

words.definitionEn: the biggest part of a meal
words.exampleEn: For the main course, I'll have the chicken.

words.definitionEn: without meat or fish
words.exampleEn: Do you have any vegetarian dishes?

words.definitionEn: with a strong hot taste
words.exampleEn: Is this dish very spicy?

words.definitionEn: to ask for food or drinks in a restaurant
words.exampleEn: Are you ready to order?

words.definitionEn: a small dish before the main course
words.exampleEn: I'll have the soup as a starter.

words.definitionEn: having a bad reaction to something you eat or touch
words.exampleEn: I'm allergic to nuts.

words.definitionEn: a paper that shows how much you have to pay
words.exampleEn: Could we have the bill, please?

words.definitionEn: extra money you give for good service
words.exampleEn: In the US, people usually leave a fifteen percent tip.
words.exampleTr: ABD'de insanlar genelde yüzde on beş bahşiş bırakır.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.en: Good evening. Do you have a reservation?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: No, we don't. A table for two, please.
dialogue.tr: Hayır, yok. İki kişilik bir masa lütfen.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.en: Of course. Follow me, please. Here's the menu.
dialogue.tr: Tabii. Lütfen beni takip edin. Menü burada.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.en: Can I get you something to drink?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Could I have some water, please?

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.en: Still or sparkling?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Still, please. What do you recommend for the main course?
dialogue.tr: Gazsız lütfen. Ana yemek için ne önerirsiniz?

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.en: The grilled salmon is very popular. We also have a vegetarian pasta.
dialogue.tr: Izgara somon çok tercih ediliyor. Vejetaryen bir makarnamız da var.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Is the pasta spicy?

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.en: Just a little. Are you ready to order?
dialogue.tr: Sadece biraz. Sipariş vermeye hazır mısınız?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Yes. I'll have the tomato soup as a starter and then the salmon, please.
dialogue.tr: Evet. Başlangıç olarak domates çorbası, sonra da somon alayım lütfen.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Oh, and I'm allergic to nuts. Is that OK?
dialogue.tr: Ha, bir de kuruyemişe alerjim var. Sorun olur mu?

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.en: No problem. There are no nuts in those dishes.
dialogue.tr: Sorun değil. O yemeklerde kuruyemiş yok.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Excuse me, could we have the bill, please?

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.en: Sure, here you are. You can pay by card or in cash.
dialogue.tr: Tabii, buyurun. Kartla veya nakit ödeyebilirsiniz.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Is the tip included?

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.en: No, it isn't, but it's up to you.

scenarios.descriptionTr: Adres söyleme, süre ve ücret sorma, yol tarifi ve ödeme.

words.definitionEn: drive me to a place
words.noteTr: Kibar hali: 'Could you take me to ...?'
words.exampleEn: Could you take me to the airport, please?

words.definitionEn: the details of where a building is
words.exampleEn: Here is the address of my hotel.

words.definitionEn: used to ask about time
words.noteTr: 'How long does it take?' = Ne kadar sürer?
words.exampleEn: How long does it take to get to the station?

words.definitionEn: the cars and other vehicles on a road
words.exampleEn: There's a lot of traffic in the morning.

words.definitionEn: the money you pay for a journey
words.exampleEn: How much is the fare to the city center?

words.definitionEn: a machine in a taxi that shows the price
words.exampleEn: Could you turn on the meter, please?

words.definitionEn: the main central part of a city
words.exampleEn: Is your hotel in the city center?

words.definitionEn: to change direction
words.exampleEn: Turn right at the traffic lights.

words.definitionEn: in a line, without turning
words.exampleEn: Go straight for two blocks.

words.definitionEn: to drive to the side of the road and stop
words.exampleEn: Could you pull over here, please?

words.definitionEn: you don't need to give me the extra money back
words.exampleEn: Here's twenty dollars. Keep the change.

words.definitionEn: a paper that shows you have paid
words.exampleEn: Can I have a receipt, please?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.en: Hi. Could you take me to the Hilton Hotel, please?
dialogue.tr: Merhaba. Beni Hilton Otel'e götürebilir misiniz lütfen?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.en: Sure. Do you have the address?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.en: Yes, here it is. How long does it take to get there?
dialogue.tr: Evet, işte burada. Oraya gitmek ne kadar sürer?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.en: About twenty minutes, but there's a lot of traffic right now.
dialogue.tr: Yaklaşık yirmi dakika ama şu an çok trafik var.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.en: How much is the fare, more or less?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.en: Usually around thirty dollars. I'll use the meter.
dialogue.tr: Genelde otuz dolar civarı. Taksimetre kullanacağım.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.en: OK, great. Is the hotel in the city center?
dialogue.tr: Tamam, harika. Otel şehir merkezinde mi?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.en: Yes, it's right in the city center.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.en: We're almost there. I'll turn right here and then go straight.
dialogue.tr: Neredeyse geldik. Burada sağa dönüp sonra düz gideceğim.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.en: Could you pull over in front of the entrance, please?
dialogue.tr: Girişin önünde kenara çekebilir misiniz lütfen?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.en: Of course. That's twenty-eight dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.en: Here's thirty. Keep the change.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.en: Can I have a receipt, please?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.en: Here you go. Have a nice day!

scenarios.descriptionTr: Şikayetini anlatma, reçetesiz ilaç isteme, kullanım ve yan etki sorma.

words.definitionEn: to experience an emotion or a physical feeling
words.noteTr: 'I don't feel well' = Kendimi iyi hissetmiyorum.
words.exampleEn: I don't feel well today.

words.definitionEn: a pain in your head
words.exampleEn: I have a terrible headache.
words.exampleTr: Çok kötü bir baş ağrım var.

words.definitionEn: a pain in your throat
words.exampleEn: I have a sore throat and I can't speak much.

words.definitionEn: a sign of an illness
words.exampleEn: What are your symptoms?

words.definitionEn: the act or sound of pushing air out of your throat
words.exampleEn: This syrup is good for a cough.

words.definitionEn: a body temperature that is higher than normal
words.exampleEn: I think I have a fever.

words.definitionEn: a paper from a doctor for medicine
words.exampleEn: You need a prescription for this medicine.

words.definitionEn: a medicine that reduces pain
words.exampleEn: Do you have any painkillers?

words.definitionEn: something you take to get better when you are ill
words.exampleEn: Don't forget to take your medicine.

words.definitionEn: two times every day
words.noteTr: once a day = günde bir kez, three times a day = günde üç kez.
words.exampleEn: Take one tablet twice a day.
words.exampleTr: Günde iki kez bir tablet alın.

words.definitionEn: an extra, usually bad, effect of a medicine
words.exampleEn: Are there any side effects?
words.exampleTr: Herhangi bir yan etkisi var mı?

words.definitionEn: tired and wanting to sleep
words.exampleEn: This medicine may make you drowsy.

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.en: Hello, how can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Hi. I don't feel very well. I have a headache and a sore throat.
dialogue.tr: Merhaba. Kendimi pek iyi hissetmiyorum. Başım ve boğazım ağrıyor.

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.en: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have any other symptoms?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Yes, a bit of a cough. But I don't think I have a fever.
dialogue.tr: Evet, biraz öksürüğüm var. Ama ateşim olduğunu sanmıyorum.

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.en: Do you have a prescription from a doctor?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: No, I don't. Can I get something without a prescription?
dialogue.tr: Hayır, yok. Reçetesiz bir şey alabilir miyim?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.en: Yes. These painkillers are good for headaches, and this syrup is for your cough.
dialogue.tr: Evet. Bu ağrı kesiciler baş ağrısına iyi gelir, bu şurup da öksürüğünüz için.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: How should I take the medicine?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.en: Take one tablet twice a day, after meals.
dialogue.tr: Günde iki kez, yemeklerden sonra bir tablet alın.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Are there any side effects?
dialogue.tr: Herhangi bir yan etkisi var mı?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.en: The syrup may make you a little drowsy, so don't drive after you take it.
dialogue.tr: Şurup biraz uyku hali yapabilir, o yüzden aldıktan sonra araba kullanmayın.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: OK, thank you so much.

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.en: You're welcome. If you don't feel better in three days, please see a doctor.
dialogue.tr: Rica ederim. Üç gün içinde iyileşmezseniz lütfen bir doktora görünün.

scenarios.descriptionTr: Tanışma, nereli olduğunu ve ne iş yaptığını sorma, sohbeti sürdürme.

words.definitionEn: a polite thing to say when you meet someone for the first time
words.exampleEn: Hi, I'm Ali. Nice to meet you.
words.exampleTr: Merhaba, ben Ali. Tanıştığıma memnun oldum.

words.definitionEn: a question to ask about someone's country or city
words.exampleEn: So, where are you from?

words.definitionEn: used to ask the same question back
words.noteTr: 'And you?' ile aynı anlamda. Sohbeti karşı tarafa geçirmenin en kolay yolu.
words.exampleEn: I'm from Istanbul. How about you?

words.definitionEn: at first; where you come from at the beginning
words.exampleEn: I live in Berlin, but I'm originally from Turkey.

words.definitionEn: on a holiday, not working
words.exampleEn: Are you here on vacation or for work?
words.exampleTr: Burada tatilde misin yoksa iş için mi?

words.definitionEn: the first occasion something happens
words.exampleEn: Is this your first time in Spain?

words.meaningTr: geçimini sağlamak için (ne iş yaptığını sorarken)
words.definitionEn: as your job
words.noteTr: 'What do you do for a living?' = Ne iş yapıyorsun? Kısaca 'What do you do?' da denir.
words.exampleEn: What do you do for a living?

words.definitionEn: a person who writes computer programs
words.exampleEn: I work as a software developer in Istanbul.

words.definitionEn: until now
words.exampleEn: I really like the city so far.
words.exampleTr: Şu ana kadar şehri gerçekten sevdim.

words.definitionEn: very good; surprising
words.exampleEn: The view from the hotel is amazing.

words.definitionEn: to continue to talk or write to someone
words.exampleEn: It was great to meet you. Let's keep in touch!

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.en: Hi! Is this seat free?

dialogue.speaker: Can
dialogue.en: Yes, sure. Please sit down.

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.en: Thanks. I'm Emma, by the way.

dialogue.speaker: Can
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you, Emma. I'm Can.
dialogue.tr: Tanıştığıma memnun oldum Emma. Ben Can.

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you too. Where are you from?

dialogue.speaker: Can
dialogue.en: I'm from Turkey, from Istanbul. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.en: I live in London, but I'm originally from Canada.

dialogue.speaker: Can
dialogue.en: Cool! Are you here on vacation?

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.en: Yes, it's my first time here. What do you do for a living?
dialogue.tr: Evet, buraya ilk gelişim. Sen ne iş yapıyorsun?

dialogue.speaker: Can
dialogue.en: I'm a software developer. And you?

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.en: I'm a teacher. So, how do you like the city so far?
dialogue.tr: Ben öğretmenim. Peki şehri şu ana kadar nasıl buldun?

dialogue.speaker: Can
dialogue.en: It's amazing! The food is great.

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.en: It was nice talking to you. Let's keep in touch!

dialogue.speaker: Can
dialogue.en: Sure. See you around!
